in_memory_source_projection.meaning: Obtain the exact existing frozen byte literal in memory; no synthesis, transformation, newline conversion or filesystem write. Authenticate the original pinned authorization and its source identity before any materialization; compare full obtained bytes, size and SHA256 independently.

sandbox_materialization.meaning: Exclusive write and readback of exactly the authenticated 239 bytes at the single sandbox path. It mutates ephemeral preparation state, not the scenario object or repository.

javac_compilation.meaning: The exact bounded compiler transforms these bytes into an inert classfile; it does not load, initialize, instantiate or invoke SyntheticStateBox. Compiler JVM infrastructure activity is not scenario activation. Exact closed inputs and absence of processor/plugin/dependency inputs are mandatory.

JVM_startup.meaning: Launching the scenario-executing JVM is the first authorized activation operation: its exact main may load, initialize and construct the scenario before a field read. Spend runtime and BEFORE permissions before this launch. This class applies to the scenario launch, not compiler JVM startup or an independently proved inert infrastructure JVM.

class_loading.meaning: Target class loading/linking is reserved to the activated consumer. Passive reading/hashing/parsing classfile bytes is preparation. Loading is distinct from initialization; neither is permitted by preparation authority.
class_loading.intrinsic_semantics: Noninitializing loading/linking alone need not execute this class's method or mutate its instance state. The classification is the conservative authority boundary for loading by the scenario consumer, whose full loader/harness is not yet frozen; it is not a claim that all JVM metadata loading is behavior.

class_initialization.meaning: The frozen source declares no static field initializer or static block. No arbitrary initialization is assumed safe; any changed source, injected class or unreviewed harness fails before activation.

object_construction.meaning: The implicit constructor initializes the instance field value to 10, before BEFORE observation. Only ordinary exact construction by the future reviewed harness is in scope; constructor reflection remains forbidden.

BEFORE_reflection_read.meaning: Exact role-specific value:int read of the constructed instance, after both runtime and BEFORE reflection lease commits. Consumed permission is not proof of a read.

first_behavioral_effect.boundary: Immediately before spawning the scenario-executing JVM, after runtime consume and the nonbehavioral BEFORE permission commit; no target loading, initialization or construction occurs earlier.
first_behavioral_effect.consume_immediately_before_means: No intervening preparation or behavioral operation after runtime commit; only required BEFORE permission authentication/commit and exact launch dispatch. Any failed check aborts; no refund or retry with the spent activation.
first_behavioral_effect.conflict: Exact frozen source has private int value = 10; ordinary construction initializes mutable scenario state before the BEFORE read. The full executable harness is not frozen and could act earlier still. The explicit historical first-effect assertion cannot truthfully coexist with those semantics.
first_behavioral_effect.rationale: Proposed launch placement preserves the frozen relative sequence and abstract consume-before-first-effect principle, but supersedes an explicit frozen first-effect assertion. Preserve history unchanged and require separately reviewed requirement evolution before implementation. Source/harness ready must mean authenticated inert artifacts, not a running JVM or initialized object.

ordering.AFTER_permission_handoff: The reviewed consumer must pause before AFTER read until the host owner authenticates and consumes AFTER permission. No caller Boolean or prewritten permission string can grant the read. The exact harness/controller protocol requires a later implementation review.

authority_separation.source_identity_authority: Existing unchanged pinned authorization public validator, transitively retaining its exact source/scenario and provider graph; source bytes alone are not authority.
authority_separation.sandbox_materialization_authority: Proposed independent exact preparation owner; only a live original preparation authority's materialization facet, delegated to its bound already-authorized sandbox controller, may permit the single exclusive source write.
authority_separation.scenario_compilation_authority: The same proposed owner, separately scoped compilation facet, permits one fixed compiler attempt after verified materialization. It is not inherited from pinned auth, runtime lease, reflection permissions, or JAVA.1C provider evidence.
authority_separation.runtime_activation_authority: Existing exact pinned runtime lease only; prepare never consumes or expands it.
authority_separation.reflection_permission: Existing exact pinned BEFORE/AFTER admissions and reflection leases only.
authority_separation.effect_evidence: Authenticated observations after actual effects; neither capability possession, compilation nor terminal permission state is behavior success.
authority_separation.preparation_authority_design: One narrow one-shot preparation authority plus one immutable success receipt. Two non-interchangeable operation facets bind one fixed materialize-then-compile attempt. No generic file or command API; no independent capability per field.
authority_separation.authority_lifetime: Issuing process and exact runtime ISSUED interval; one original authorization/runtime/workspace generation. Reserve each effect facet immediately before its attempted operation; failures spend the attempt and publish no success receipt. No reissue or refund for the same bound attempt.
authority_issuance_requires: original publicly authenticated pinned auth/runtime graph
live independently authorized SANDBOX.2 workspace and exact controller binding
no existing attempt tombstone for exact runtime/workspace generation

materialization.workspace_kind: already-authorized container-local ephemeral tmpfs; never host repository or bind mount
materialization.initial_workspace: empty, exclusively owned by one attempt; no image volume, host mount, shared writer, preexisting source/class or other Java input
materialization.file_count_scope: /work source/output workspace; /tmp is separately bounded by the exact SANDBOX.2 tmpfs policy and must contain no compiler input, exported artifact or retained file after teardown
materialization.symlink_policy: Allow only the independently verified expected /work tmpfs root mount; reject unexpected/subordinate mount crossings, symlinks, hardlink aliases and special files at destination/output and workspace path components. lstat/descriptor-relative no-follow checks, exclusive creation and single-link regular file readback; no path re-resolution race or shared writer.
materialization.path_policy: No caller path; exact absolute POSIX allowlist. Reject NUL, backslash, dot/parent components, path aliases, traversal, unexpected entries and root escapes before any write.
materialization.overwrite_policy: Never overwrite or truncate existing paths; binary exclusive creation only. Existing file/directory conflicts abort the attempt, including byte-identical files.
materialization.byte_policy: Copy existing exact frozen bytes only, full size/hash and byte-for-byte readback; no encoding/newline conversion, regeneration, formatting or rewriting.

compiler.template_derivation: Recover every flag and output path unchanged from JAVA.1C; explicitly freeze only the scenario source operand substitution as new scope. Historical invocation, controller and provider remain unchanged and cannot perform this operation.
compiler.input_closure: Only the exact frozen source and immutable pinned JDK/image; no class/JAR/processor/service/config inputs in initially empty cwd or writable tmpfs, no source imports/annotations, no caller CLASSPATH/JDK_JAVAC_OPTIONS/JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS/_JAVA_OPTIONS. Do not invent -proc:none or other flags.

sandbox.environment_source: Exact eight-variable core.candidate_runtime_sandbox._WORKLOAD_ENVIRONMENT, source-pinned in evidence_index.json; no caller environment extension.
sandbox.remaining_checks: Every unchanged SANDBOX.2 inspection/ladder/resource/namespace/cgroup/controller gate; same backend route/version, immutable image and authenticated actual workspace/container generation.
sandbox.live_workspace_requirement: Provider proof's successfully cleaned workspace is historical evidence, never the scenario workspace. A separate authorized live workspace must be authenticated and bound to the original provider graph by public evidence. This contract grants no sandbox/container issuance.

compile_output.bound_basis: Adopt the frozen JAVA.1C 1..32768 single-class envelope; scenario class bytes/size/hash have not been measured.
compile_output.manifest: Full sorted no-follow workspace manifest: exact directory/file types, paths, sizes, SHA256 for source and class, no extra files, same source bytes before/after. Parse bounded classfile metadata as inert data to check internal class identity; never load it for verification.
compile_output.unexpected_file_behavior: COMPILE_OUTPUT_MISMATCH; publish no ready receipt, revoke preparation eligibility, tear down entire attempt workspace. No selective retention, new flags, retry or fallback.
success_requirements: bounded complete empty stdout/stderr and both EOFs, preserving JAVA.1C diagnostic expectations
compiler process fully reaped without timeout
exact single output set and byte bounds
signed output/source manifest and compiler/context measurements

preparation_receipt.harness_claim: Scenario receipt does not prove a harness exists or has compiled. Its explicit exclusion prevents scenario output evidence from being misused as whole-executor readiness.
preparation_receipt.lifetime: Same issuing host process, exact live attempt/container/workspace generation and unchanged original graph/artifacts. No wall-clock Boolean or timestamp alone establishes freshness. Timeout/abort/teardown, changed manifest, controller disconnect or terminal runtime state ends preactivation readiness.
preparation_receipt.reusable: Read-only evidence may be revalidated repeatedly during one live attempt, including for final audit; it grants no repeat preparation or execution. Post-teardown authenticity may survive as evidence, readiness may not.

harness_identity.readiness_requirement: A separately reviewed consumer contract must pin full harness source bytes/hash/size, compiler/input/output manifests, main/JVM argv, controller protocol/source and exact executable identities; authenticate their original preparation evidence. No caller-selected hash or renderer fingerprint substitutes. No harness source/output is permitted by this scenario preparation authority.

consumer_readiness.freshness: Reauthenticate all originals/public signed current-state APIs and the live sealed/exclusively controlled artifact snapshot at final activation handoff. State checks are snapshots, not reservations. Changed bytes, lost controller, new workspace generation, terminal state, timeout/abort or revoked/invalidated upstream makes it stale.
consumer_readiness.reusable: Validation is read-only and repeatable only before this exact runtime activation; no permission or lease state of its own.
consumer_readiness.consumption_invalidates_it: Runtime consumption makes it ineligible for any later preactivation/consume attempt; retain evidence authenticatable for audit. No new readiness consumption state, refund or second runtime lease.
consumer_readiness.authentication: Exact type, original live owner-registry object, independent process-local HMAC secret, wrong-PID rejection before locks, retained original upstream identities and mandatory unchanged public validators; matching scalar projections are insufficient.
consumer_readiness.runtime_integration: Subject to requirement evolution: authenticate full consumer/upstream graph outside runtime lock, then at existing _consumer_readiness gate verify only narrow locally authenticated handoff binding/freshness before locked terminal commit. No callback from the non-reentrant runtime lock into public runtime/reflection graph validators. Existing public signatures/policy remain unchanged here; exact future API/lock order needs review, never private-registry access or automatic contract-file import.
consumer_readiness.race_policy: Do not claim cross-owner atomicity. Consumer exclusively controls live artifacts until launch; runtime repeats local original auth/state checks under its lock and accepts only a freshly authenticated narrow handoff without recursive upstream locking. Full reflection public rechecks occur outside runtime lock and at each reflection consume. An upstream race or integrity loss aborts before the next affected guarded effect; earlier effects are not undone, and activation is never refunded after commit.

evidence_authentication.canonical_payload: Exact primitive/nested types; sorted compact JSON, allow_nan=false, UTF-8; domain + NUL + role + NUL + canonical bytes

cleanup.owner: Proposed preparation owner owns attempt workspace lifecycle; future consumer borrows an exclusive artifact handoff; bound sandbox controller performs cleanup and independent absence observation.
cleanup.on_preparation_failure: No ready receipt. Kill/reap compiler children/process groups, close pipes/selectors and observe EOF, tear down entire workspace/container, independently verify absence. Failed cleanup is separately recorded and blocks further readiness; never silently claim success.
cleanup.after_preparation_success: Keep exact source/class in same ephemeral workspace only until consumer completion, abort, timeout or authorization/readiness loss. Receipt states live artifacts with cleanup pending; no premature removal or cleanup success claim.
cleanup.after_behavior_or_abandonment: Reap every child/process group, close captures, remove whole scenario container/workspace including /work and /tmp, independently verify absence and record separate cleanup evidence. Consumer failure spends activation and still requires cleanup.
cleanup.persistent_artifacts: No source, class, harness, workspace snapshot or raw byte dump survives final cleanup. Bounded source-free/class-free metadata reports, sizes, hashes, manifests and cleanup observations may survive as report-only audit evidence; no secrets or serialized restorable authority.

error_taxonomy.SOURCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: Authenticated scenario/source kind/hash/size/definition differs from the fixed scope; semantic mismatch, not authentication failure.
error_taxonomy.SOURCE_BYTES_MISMATCH: Obtained, materialized or readback bytes/size/hash differ from exact authenticated bytes.
error_taxonomy.MATERIALIZATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED: No authentic unspent materialization facet for this original graph/workspace.
error_taxonomy.COMPILATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED: No authentic unspent exact compilation facet, or materialization prerequisite absent.
error_taxonomy.COMPILER_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: Authentic measured executable/image/provider/controller binding differs from pins.
error_taxonomy.COMPILE_FAILED: Nonzero exit, timeout, truncated/over-limit capture, unreaped child or incomplete EOF evidence; no success receipt.
error_taxonomy.COMPILE_OUTPUT_MISMATCH: Wrong class path/type/count/size/internal identity/manifest, unexpected output or changed source.
error_taxonomy.HARNESS_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: Authentic full harness/controller/renderer/helper/main/launch evidence differs from separately reviewed exact pins.
error_taxonomy.PREPARATION_EVIDENCE_UNAUTHENTICATED: Nonoriginal, wrong exact type/process, invalid owner signature or original upstream authentication failure; preserve upstream code/reason.
error_taxonomy.PREPARATION_EVIDENCE_STALE: Authentic evidence lost live workspace/artifact generation, control channel, integrity or current eligibility.
error_taxonomy.CONSUMER_READINESS_UNAUTHENTICATED: Consumer evidence exact type/original/PID/signature/upstream authentication failure.
error_taxonomy.CONSUMER_READINESS_UNRESOLVED: Missing/unimplemented reviewed exact consumer, full harness/protocol/primitive/live proof; never accept a caller Boolean.
error_taxonomy.CLEANUP_UNRESOLVED: Cleanup failed, timed out or independent absence observation missing; distinct from preparation/behavior result.
error_taxonomy.PROOF_UNRESOLVED: Unknown or unavailable trusted proof/validator; overall current runtime fail-closed result. Known semantic or upstream typed categories are retained separately.

requirement_evolution.required_revision: An explicitly reviewed additive requirement must supersede only the historical first-effect assertion, identify scenario JVM dispatch as the conservative activation boundary and distinguish source-level construction/initialization from BEFORE observation. Preserve existing source bytes, relative runtime/reflection order, no-refund policy and independent authority separation.
requirement_evolution.proposed_rules_status: Contract analysis and bounded downstream design; not accepted operational requirements until requirement evolution resolves the conflict.
